ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver — this ruling concerns trip TRP-02840 (Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd to Blk 503 Bishan St 11).

THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. The governing measurement is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02840), which records 29.0 km driven against the booked optimal of 20.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02840) — an excess of 9.0 km, or 45.00% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (over 20% and over 0.8 km), and because the excess also exceeds 8.0 km in absolute terms it is a MATERIAL deviation requiring the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check. The trace is intact for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 228 fixes, a steady 10-second sample interval with no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0) and no >500 m jump, so limbs (a) to (c) are not engaged and the measured figure stands without independent corroboration.

THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXCUSE CARRIES NO WEIGHT. The only explanation on file is the driver's statement 'Heavy traffic.' The bundle holds no traffic advisory for this trip (EV-ADVIS-02840-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — no advisory covers the Yishun Ring Rd corridor in this window), so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, the clause is unavailable and an uncited traffic assertion discharges nothing under POL-RD-08. Because no advisory identifier was cited, this is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) describes, so it does not escalate. No other excuse applies: the chat log is empty (0 messages, so no POL-RD-04 rider-requested detour), pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null with amended_optimal_distance_km null (no POL-RD-05 relocation), and the vehicle was RYDE_X, not a pooled itinerary (no POL-RD-12).

THE REFUND IS ARITHMETIC UNDER POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED. Charged_total = 51.38 (EV-FARE-02840). Recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 × 20.0 km + 0.28 × 26.0 min) × 1.4 surge, read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 surcharges + 0 waiting fee − 0 promo = (26.08 × 1.4) + 0.80 = 37.3120. Refund = 51.38 − 37.3120 = 14.0680, rounded UP to SGD 14.10. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 14.10. It is less than the SGD 25.00 the rider contested, because the policy pays the arithmetic shortfall on the fare and no round-number or discretionary sum; the claim for the full contested amount is not supported.

NO UPLIFT, NO PASS-THROUGH, NO CONDUCT REFERRAL. The driver's profile shows no repeat-deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 against completed_trips_90d 278), so neither POL-RD-06 limb is met: no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. The fare_breakdown carries no ERP, toll or airport surcharge line, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and there is no billing-integrity finding. The rider's own profile (deviation_claims_60d 0) raises no extra corroboration requirement under POL-RD-08.

EXECUTION. The monetary effect (SGD 14.10) exceeds the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold in the general policy, so this provisional ruling is issued but not executed automatically; it is placed in the human release queue. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

Confidence is 0.90, at or below the weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02840, EV-TRIP-02840 and EV-FARE-02840, each weight 1.0) and above the platform floor.
